plants <- timedFread("tabular_data/AHSBR_Tracheophyta_ultimate-catalogue_2026-06-16-selected-labels.csv")

## In Memory of Plants

The Sḵwx̱wú7mesh Úxwumixw (Squamish Nation) have cared for the lands and waters of Átl’ḵa7tsem since time immemorial.

The memory preserved here is much more limited: collected specimens, names written down on lists, and observations shared through iNaturalist, reaching back to `r first.year`.

Each record is a moment when someone stopped to take note of a plant.

Some plants have long been recorded, while others have appeared only in more recent years. Still others have gone unseen for decades, [quietly disappearing from the record.](#pane:LostPlants){.howe-traces-next}
